articles.author: Reuters Staff
articles.title: Moldova signs EU integration agreement
articles.description: The Republic of Moldova today signed a landmark EU integration agreement in Brussels.
articles.content: BRUSSELS (Reuters) - Moldova signed a comprehensive EU integration agreement on Monday, marking a significant step toward European membership. The agreement covers trade, judicial reform, and visa liberalization.

articles.author: AP Staff
articles.title: Transnistria talks resume after months of stalemate
articles.description: Negotiations over Transnistria's status resumed in Vienna after a six-month pause.
articles.content: VIENNA (AP) - Talks over the status of Transnistria resumed in Vienna on Monday, with diplomats expressing cautious optimism about progress.
